C. Comments Received as a Result of the Circulation of the Draft Environmental Statement
An evaluation and disposition of comments received as a result of the circulation of the <u>Draft Design Environmental Statement/Section 4(f)</u> for Lincoln Highway (Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road) Cook County, Illinois is contained on the following pages. This statement was cleared by FHWA for circulation and comments on April 4, 1972 and mailed to the various commenting agencies on April 14, 1972. A copy of the Federal, State and Local comments received is contained in Appendix A.
